description: Generalized past-time detection (audit commit ad3641395). The hasPastTimeMarker helper drives rule en-yesterday-irregular-beginner-past, which rewrites a beginner present-tense irregular verb (buy/do/eat/go/have) to its past form ONLY when a recognized past-time marker is present AND a (subject pronoun + target verb) adjacency exists. The audit's negation lookahead (?!\s+not\b) keeps it from mangling negated past. This golden set locks that firing surface and its false-positive boundary. Expectations encode the VERIFIED behavior on current main; coverage-gap cases lock today's no-fire behavior and are flagged for Lane A.

cases.input: Yesterday I go to school
cases.expectedCorrection: Yesterday I went to school.
cases.notes: Standard past-tense verb correction after 'yesterday' (go -> went).

cases.input: Last week I buy a book
cases.expectedCorrection: Last week I bought a book.
cases.notes: 'last week' marker (buy -> bought).

cases.input: Last night I eat rice
cases.expectedCorrection: Last night I ate rice.
cases.notes: 'last night' marker (eat -> ate).

cases.input: Two days ago I go to Hanoi
cases.expectedCorrection: Two days ago I went to Hanoi.
cases.notes: '<N> days ago' marker (go -> went).

cases.input: Three weeks ago I have a fever
cases.expectedCorrection: Three weeks ago I had a fever.
cases.notes: '<N> weeks ago' marker (have -> had).

cases.input: Last Monday I do my homework
cases.expectedCorrection: Last Monday I did my homework.
cases.notes: 'last <weekday>' marker (do -> did).

cases.input: Last year I go to Japan
cases.expectedCorrection: Last year I went to Japan.
cases.notes: 'last year' marker (go -> went).

cases.input: The day before yesterday I eat pho
cases.expectedCorrection: The day before yesterday I ate pho.
cases.notes: Compound marker containing 'yesterday' (eat -> ate).

cases.input: Tomorrow I go to school
cases.expectedCorrection: Tomorrow I go to school.
cases.notes: FP-stress: future marker 'tomorrow' must NOT trigger past-tense rewrite.

cases.input: Next week I buy a book
cases.expectedCorrection: Next week I buy a book.
cases.notes: FP-stress: 'next week' is future; the 'last <unit>' lookalike must not fire.

cases.input: I will go to school next week
cases.expectedCorrection: I will go to school next week.
cases.notes: FP-stress: future modal 'will go' + 'next week' must not be rewritten to past.

cases.input: If I had known, I would have gone yesterday
cases.expectedCorrection: If I had known, I would have gone yesterday.
cases.notes: FP-stress: 'yesterday' present but the sentence is already correct conditional past; no (pronoun + target-verb) adjacency, so the rule correctly abstains.

cases.input: Back in the day I go to the gym
cases.expectedCorrection: Back in the day I go to the gym.
cases.notes: FP-stress: idiom 'back in the day' is not a recognized past marker; rule must not fire.

cases.input: Yesterday's homework is due tomorrow
cases.expectedCorrection: Yesterday's homework is due tomorrow.
cases.notes: FP-stress: nested time refs — possessive 'Yesterday's' + future 'tomorrow', no target verb. Marker present but rule must abstain.

cases.input: Every day I go to school
cases.expectedCorrection: Every day I go to school.
cases.notes: FP-stress: present habitual, no past marker; 'go' must stay present.

cases.input: Yesterday I went to school
cases.expectedCorrection: Yesterday I went to school.
cases.notes: FP-stress: already-correct past ('went') must not be re-touched even with 'yesterday' present.

cases.input: Yesterday I do not go to school
cases.notes: FP-stress: negation guard (?!\s+not\b) blocks the deterministic 'do -> did' rewrite, so the rule produces no change; the engine then escalates to needs_ai rather than emitting a wrong fix.

cases.input: Do you go to school every day?
cases.expectedCorrection: Do you go to school every day?
cases.notes: FP-stress: question form, no past marker; rule must not fire.

cases.input: On Monday I go to school
cases.expectedCorrection: On Monday I go to school.
cases.notes: COVERAGE GAP (current main): 'on <weekday>' is NOT recognized by hasPastTimeMarker (only 'last <weekday>'), so a learner's past intent is left uncorrected. Behavior locked as-is; flagged for Lane A, not fixed here.

cases.input: In 2024 I go to Japan
cases.expectedCorrection: In 2024 I go to Japan.
cases.notes: COVERAGE GAP (current main): explicit year 'in <year>' is not a recognized past marker. Behavior locked as-is; flagged for Lane A, not fixed here.

cases.input: An hour ago I eat lunch
cases.expectedCorrection: An hour ago I eat lunch.
cases.notes: COVERAGE GAP (current main): the '<N> ... ago' pattern only covers day/week/month/year units, so 'an hour ago' does not fire. Behavior locked as-is; flagged for Lane A, not fixed here.

cases.input: Last summer I go to the beach
cases.expectedCorrection: Last summer I go to the beach.
cases.notes: COVERAGE GAP (current main): 'last <season>' is not in the 'last <unit/weekday>' set, so it does not fire. Behavior locked as-is; flagged for Lane A, not fixed here.
